_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate over 63 windows demands HOLD — calling a direction here requires seeing a breaker that 63 consecutive windows didn't produce, and neither brain has identified a confirmed trigger.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call Denial now, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief with HOLD while the narrative implies an eventual UP reversal; the analyst's trust weight (7.67) and stronger evidence-based caution overrides the narrative's optimism.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain above 30 AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 50 with cvd_btc_pct_30d breaking above 40
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 20 with funding rate jumping above 0.015% AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d rolling over below 90, indicating distribution into risk-off
